description: Finish the audio engine implementation using rodio for sound effects, audio cues, and background audio during rides. Includes countdown sounds, achievement chimes, and optional workout music playback.

phases.name: Core Rodio Integration
phases.description: Implement the core rodio audio playback functionality in the AudioEngine, including sound file loading and tone generation integration.

subtasks.title: Implement RodioAudioBackend for sound file playback
subtasks.description: Create a RodioAudioBackend struct that manages the rodio OutputStream and Sink. Implement methods for loading and playing WAV/MP3 sound files from the assets/sounds directory. Handle audio device initialization with proper error recovery.
acceptance_criteria: RodioAudioBackend initializes rodio OutputStream on creation
Can load WAV and MP3 files from disk
Plays sounds without blocking the main thread
Handles missing audio device gracefully with error logging
subtasks.notes: Implemented RodioAudioBackend in src/audio/backend.rs with: OutputStream/Sink management, WAV/MP3 loading, sound caching, non-blocking playback, volume control, mute functionality, and graceful error recovery for missing audio devices. Created assets/sounds directory structure. Exported types from mod.rs.

subtasks.title: Integrate ToneGenerator with AudioEngine
subtasks.description: Connect the existing ToneGenerator to the DefaultAudioEngine so that play_tone() actually produces audio output. Replace the TODO stub with actual tone generation using the existing tones.rs implementation.
acceptance_criteria: play_tone() produces audible sine wave output
Volume from AudioConfig is applied to tones
Tones can be interrupted by higher-priority audio
subtasks.notes: Connected RodioAudioBackend to DefaultAudioEngine so play_tone() produces actual audio output. Implemented: play_tone() with rodio SineWave, volume propagation from AudioConfig, mute state handling, backend initialization in initialize(), stop_all() integration, audio_backend() accessor, AudioItem::tone() helper. Added comprehensive tests for backend integration.

subtasks.title: Implement sound file loading and caching in AudioEngine
subtasks.description: Replace the play_sound() TODO stub with actual implementation. Load sound files on-demand from assets/sounds/, cache decoded audio in memory for fast replay. Support named sound effects like 'countdown_tick', 'achievement_chime', etc.
acceptance_criteria: play_sound('name') loads and plays corresponding audio file
Sound files are cached after first load
Volume controls affect sound playback
Unknown sound names log warning and don't crash
subtasks.notes: Replaced play_sound() TODO stub with actual backend integration. play_sound('name') now loads and plays corresponding audio files via RodioAudioBackend. Sound files are cached after first load. Volume controls affect sound playback. Unknown sound names log a warning and don't crash. Uses spawn_blocking for non-blocking async playback. Added unit tests for sound audio items and sound effects configuration.

subtasks.title: Create sound asset definitions and placeholder files
subtasks.description: Define the sound asset catalog (countdown_tick, interval_change, achievement_bronze/silver/gold, workout_start, workout_complete, etc.). Create the assets/sounds directory structure. Generate placeholder tone-based sounds programmatically if no real audio files are available.
acceptance_criteria: assets/sounds/ directory exists with sound file definitions
SoundAssets enum/struct lists all available sounds
Sound catalog includes at least: countdown ticks, achievement chimes, interval alerts
Fallback to generated tones if audio files missing
subtasks.notes: Created comprehensive sound asset catalog with: SoundAsset enum (31 sounds in 8 categories - Countdown, Interval, Achievement, Milestone, Workout, Zone, Alert, Connection), SoundCategory enum for grouping, SoundDefinition struct with metadata (description, critical flag, volume multiplier), SoundCatalog API for querying sounds, fallback tone sequences for all sounds when audio files missing, achievement tones with increasing complexity by tier, countdown tones with increasing urgency (pitch). Updated assets/sounds/.gitkeep with complete documentation of expected sound files.

phases.name: Countdown Sound System
phases.description: Implement the interval countdown audio cues with configurable countdown thresholds and sound patterns.

subtasks.title: Add countdown tone patterns to CuePattern
subtasks.description: Extend the CuePattern enum with countdown-specific patterns: countdown ticks for 10/5/3/2/1 seconds, distinct patterns for the final 3-2-1 countdown. Configure frequency and duration for clear audio feedback.
acceptance_criteria: CuePattern has countdown variants (CountdownTick, CountdownFinal3, etc.)
Each countdown second has a distinct but consistent sound
Final 3-2-1 countdown has escalating urgency
Countdown sounds are short (<200ms) to not overlap with speech
subtasks.notes: Extended CuePattern enum with 5 countdown-specific patterns: CountdownTick10 (G4, 60ms), CountdownTick5 (A4, 80ms), CountdownFinal3 (B4, 100ms), CountdownFinal2 (C5, 120ms double-beep), CountdownFinal1 (D5, 150ms triple-beep). Added escalating frequencies (G4→D5) and durations for urgency. All patterns under 200ms. Added helper methods: for_countdown_seconds(), is_countdown_pattern(), is_final_countdown(). Comprehensive unit tests verify distinct sounds, duration limits, and escalating frequencies.

subtasks.title: Implement countdown audio trigger in WorkoutAudioBridge
subtasks.description: Enhance the IntervalCountdown event handling in WorkoutAudioBridge to trigger appropriate countdown sounds. Use tone patterns for countdown ticks and optionally voice for larger numbers (10 seconds, 5 seconds).
acceptance_criteria: IntervalCountdown events trigger countdown sounds
Voice announcement for 10s and 5s remaining
Tone-only for final 3-2-1
Configuration option to disable countdown sounds
subtasks.notes: Enhanced WorkoutAudioBridge with AudioEngine parameter for countdown tone playback. Implemented differentiated countdown handling: 10s/5s get voice+tone, 3s/2s/1s get tone-only (using CuePattern::for_countdown_seconds() from 2.1). Added countdown_sounds_enabled and countdown_voice_enabled config options. Added handle_countdown() and play_countdown_tone() methods. Updated all tests with MockAudioEngine and added new countdown-specific tests.

subtasks.title: Add countdown sound configuration options
subtasks.description: Extend AudioConfig and WorkoutAudioBridgeConfig with countdown-specific settings: enable/disable countdown sounds, countdown thresholds (which seconds to announce), volume level for countdown vs speech.
acceptance_criteria: countdown_enabled config option
countdown_thresholds configurable (default: [10, 5, 3, 2, 1])
countdown_volume separate from master volume
Settings persist to user configuration
subtasks.notes:
Extended AudioConfig and WorkoutAudioBridgeConfig with countdown-specific settings:

AudioConfig additions:
- countdown_enabled: bool (default: true) - Master enable for countdown sounds
- countdown_volume: u8 (default: 100) - Separate volume level for countdown audio

WorkoutAudioBridgeConfig additions:
- countdown_thresholds: Vec<u32> (default: [10, 5, 3, 2, 1]) - Which seconds to announce
- countdown_voice_thresholds: Vec<u32> (default: [10, 5]) - Subset that receive voice announcements

Updated handle_countdown() to use configurable thresholds dynamically instead of hardcoded match arms. Added serde Serialize/Deserialize with defaults for backward compatibility. Added comprehensive tests for new options and serialization.

phases.name: Achievement and Milestone Audio
phases.description: Connect the achievement notification system to audio playback for celebratory feedback.

subtasks.title: Create achievement chime patterns by tier
subtasks.description: Define CuePatterns for achievement unlocks with variation by tier: Bronze (simple chime), Silver (richer harmony), Gold (triumphant fanfare), Platinum (epic celebration). Also create patterns for level-up notifications.
acceptance_criteria: CuePattern::AchievementBronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum exist
CuePattern::LevelUp exists
Each tier has progressively more impressive sound
Sounds are satisfying but not annoying on repeated plays
subtasks.notes:
Added achievement chime patterns to CuePattern enum with progressively impressive sounds:

**New CuePattern variants:**
- AchievementBronze: Simple single-tone chime (E4, 150ms)
- AchievementSilver: Two-tone ascending harmony (G4→B4)
- AchievementGold: Three-tone triumphant fanfare (C5→E5→G5)
- AchievementPlatinum: Epic multi-note celebration with buildup and sustained finale
- LevelUp: Distinct ascending progression (D5→F#5→A5)

**New helper methods:**
- for_achievement_tier(tier: &str) - get pattern by tier name (case-insensitive)
- is_achievement_pattern() - check if pattern is achievement-related
- is_celebration_pattern() - check if pattern is celebration (achievement/level-up/success)
- achievement_tier_level() - get numeric tier level (1-4)
- achievement_tier_name() - get tier name string

**Comprehensive tests added** verifying progressive impressiveness, distinct sounds, ascending frequencies, and appropriate durations (100-1000ms range).

subtasks.title: Create AchievementAudioBridge
subtasks.description: Create a bridge component that monitors the NotificationQueue from the achievements module and triggers appropriate audio (chime + optional voice announcement). Handle concurrent achievements gracefully.
acceptance_criteria: New achievement notifications trigger tier-appropriate chime
Optional voice announcement ('Achievement unlocked: [name]')
Multiple rapid achievements queue audio properly
Level-up notifications have distinct celebration sound
subtasks.notes:
Created AchievementAudioBridge component in src/audio/achievement_bridge.rs that monitors achievement notifications and triggers audio feedback:

**New Files:**
- src/audio/achievement_bridge.rs - Main bridge component

**Key Features:**
- AchievementAudioBridgeConfig with settings for: chimes_enabled, voice_enabled, level_up_sounds/voice_enabled, max_queued_sounds, audio_spacing_ms
- handle_achievement_notification() - Plays tier-appropriate chimes and optional voice announcements
- handle_level_up() - Plays LevelUp pattern and voice announcement
- handle_multiple_achievements() - Queues multiple achievements with spacing, sorted by tier (highest first)
- tier_to_priority() - Maps Bronze/Silver to Normal, Gold/Diamond to High, Legendary to Critical priority
- Fallback patterns for Diamond (uses Gold) and Legendary (uses Platinum) since CuePattern only has Bronze-Platinum
- Queue limiting to prevent audio pileup with max_queued_sounds config

**Modified Files:**
- src/audio/alerts.rs - Added AlertData::Achievement and AlertData::Custom variants, AlertContext::achievement() and ::custom() methods
- src/audio/cues.rs - Updated expand_template() to handle new AlertData variants, enhanced AchievementUnlocked template with alternatives
- src/audio/mod.rs - Added achievement_bridge module and exports

**Tests:**
- Comprehensive tests for config, serialization, tier priority mapping, chime playback, voice announcements, level-up handling, enable/disable toggles, multiple achievements, and fallback patterns

subtasks.title: Add milestone celebration sounds
subtasks.description: Implement audio feedback for distance/time/calorie milestones. Create distinct but subtle sounds for milestone achievements to provide feedback without being intrusive during the ride.
acceptance_criteria: Distance milestones (5km, 10km, etc.) trigger subtle chime
Time milestones (15min, 30min, etc.) trigger feedback
Personal records have celebratory sound
Milestone sounds configurable (enable/disable by type)
subtasks.notes:

**Created milestone_bridge.rs:**
- MilestoneAudioBridge component for handling milestone events
- MilestoneAudioBridgeConfig with per-type enable/disable for sounds and voice

**Updated mod.rs:**
- Added milestones_enabled, milestone_volume, personal_record_sounds_enabled to AudioConfig
- Exported MilestoneAudioBridge, MilestoneAudioBridgeConfig, MilestoneData, MilestoneType

phases.name: Volume Control and Audio Settings
phases.description: Implement comprehensive volume control with separate levels for different audio types.

subtasks.title: Implement per-category volume controls
subtasks.description: Extend AudioConfig with separate volume levels for: master, voice/TTS, sound effects, countdown tones, achievement sounds. Implement volume mixing in the audio backend.
acceptance_criteria: Master volume affects all audio
Separate volume for voice, effects, and tones
Volume changes apply immediately to playing audio
Volume levels persist in user settings
subtasks.notes: Extended AudioConfig with separate volume levels for: master, voice/TTS, sound effects, countdown tones, achievement sounds, milestones. Implemented AudioCategory enum with methods: volume_from_config(), is_enabled(), effective_volume(), display_name(). Added AudioItem helper constructors for category-specific items: countdown_tone(), achievement_sound(), achievement_tone(), milestone_sound(), milestone_tone(). Updated RodioAudioBackend with play_sound_with_volume() and play_tone_with_volume() methods. Updated DefaultAudioEngine process_queue() to check item.is_enabled() and apply item.effective_volume(). Added new AudioEngine trait methods: play_sound_with_category(), play_tone_with_category(), set_category_volume(), get_category_volume(). Comprehensive tests for AudioCategory and per-category volume controls.

subtasks.title: Add mute functionality with quick toggle
subtasks.description: Implement mute/unmute functionality that can be triggered quickly during a ride. Maintain separate mute states for different audio categories if desired.
acceptance_criteria: Global mute toggle available
Mute state persists across audio items in queue
Unmuting resumes at previous volume
Visual indicator when audio is muted
subtasks.notes:
Implemented comprehensive mute/unmute functionality:

**AudioConfig additions:**
- muted: bool - Global mute state
- voice_muted, sound_effects_muted, countdown_muted, achievement_muted, milestone_muted - Per-category mute states

**AudioCategory additions:**
- is_muted(config) - Check if category is muted (global or category-specific)
- should_play(config) - Check if audio should play (enabled and not muted)
- effective_volume() now returns 0.0 when muted
- all() - Get all audio categories

**AudioItem additions:**
- should_play(config) - Check if item should play considering mute state

**MuteState struct for UI:**
- from_config(config) - Create mute state snapshot
- any_muted() - Check if any audio is muted
- is_category_muted(category) - Check specific category
- display_string() - Human-readable mute status
- icon_hint() - Icon suggestion for UI

**AudioEngine trait additions:**
- mute(), unmute(), toggle_mute(), is_muted() - Global mute control
- mute_category(), unmute_category(), toggle_category_mute(), is_category_muted() - Per-category mute
- get_mute_state() - Get current mute state for UI

**DefaultAudioEngine implementation:**
- All mute methods implemented with proper state management
- Backend mute synced with global mute
- Volume preserved during mute/unmute cycles
- process_queue updated to use should_play()

**Tests:**
- Comprehensive tests for mute state, category muting, global muting
- Tests for MuteState UI helpers
- Tests for serde serialization/backward compatibility

phases.name: Platform Reliability and Testing
phases.description: Ensure audio engine works reliably across all supported platforms with proper error handling and comprehensive tests.

subtasks.title: Implement platform-specific audio initialization
subtasks.description: Handle audio device initialization differences across Windows, macOS, and Linux. Implement fallback behavior when audio devices are unavailable. Add audio device hot-plug support where possible.
acceptance_criteria: Audio initializes correctly on Windows/macOS/Linux
Graceful fallback when no audio device present
Error messages suggest platform-specific fixes
Can recover when audio device becomes available
subtasks.notes:
Implemented platform-specific audio device initialization handling for Windows, macOS, and Linux:

**New Types (backend.rs):**
- `Platform` enum with `detect()` for runtime platform detection, `audio_backend_name()` for backend identification, and `troubleshooting_hints()` for platform-specific help
- `AudioDeviceError` struct with platform-specific user-friendly messages, raw error storage, and formatted help messages with troubleshooting steps
- `AudioDeviceStatus` struct for device monitoring with availability, state, recovery tracking, and UI helpers
- `HotPlugConfig` for hot-plug recovery configuration with exponential backoff settings

**Enhanced RodioAudioBackend:**
- Platform detection on creation with debug logging
- Enhanced `initialize()` with platform-specific pre-init checks and detailed error logging
- `reinitialize()` with recovery tracking
- `try_recovery()` implementing exponential backoff for hot-plug support
- `reset_recovery()` to allow manual recovery restart
- `get_device_status()` for monitoring and UI display
- `get_troubleshooting_hints()` for platform-specific help
- Hot-plug configuration management

**Enhanced AudioEngine:**
- Added device status methods to trait: `get_device_status()`, `get_platform()`, `is_device_available()`, `try_device_recovery()`, `reset_device_recovery()`, `get_hot_plug_config()`, `set_hot_plug_config()`, `get_troubleshooting_hints()`
- Implemented all methods in DefaultAudioEngine delegating to backend

**Comprehensive Tests:**
- Platform detection and backend names
- AudioDeviceError message generation for various error types
- AudioDeviceStatus state tracking and UI helpers
- HotPlugConfig defaults and customization
- Backend device status retrieval
- Engine device status methods

**Exported Types:**
- All new types exported from mod.rs: Platform, AudioDeviceError, AudioDeviceStatus, HotPlugConfig

subtasks.title: Add audio synchronization safeguards
subtasks.description: Implement timing safeguards to prevent audio lag, overlap, and desync issues. Add audio item expiration to drop stale queued audio. Ensure countdown sounds stay synchronized with workout timing.
acceptance_criteria: Audio queue items expire after max_queue_time
High-priority audio interrupts lower priority cleanly
No audio pileup when events come faster than playback
Countdown sounds play at correct timing relative to interval changes
subtasks.notes:
Implemented timing safeguards for audio synchronization:

1. Updated process_queue() in engine.rs:
   - Enforces min_audio_gap_ms between audio items (except time-critical)
   - Records playback end time via record_playback_end() for gap enforcement
   - Logs time-critical item playback with age tracking

2. Updated WorkoutAudioBridge with countdown sync safeguards:
   - Added countdown_max_age_ms config (default: 500ms)
   - Added use_queued_countdown config (default: true for queue-based approach)
   - Queue-based countdown tones with proper expiration via countdown_tone_with_timing()
   - Pattern expiration check before each tone
   - Legacy direct mode with timing check for backward compatibility

3. Added comprehensive tests:
   - test_countdown_event_queued_mode - verifies queue-based countdown
   - test_countdown_timing_safeguards - verifies expiration settings

All acceptance criteria met:
- Audio queue items expire after max_queue_time ✓
- High-priority audio interrupts lower priority cleanly ✓
- No audio pileup when events come faster than playback ✓
- Countdown sounds play at correct timing relative to interval changes ✓
